mapper.select: SELECT id, order_uid, campaign_id, status, paid_at FROM purchase_order WHERE order_uid = #{orderUid} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase_order SET status = 'PAID', paid_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND NOW(6) < expire_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_attempt (order_id, idempotency_key, result, created_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{result}, NOW(6))
mapper.select: SELECT r.request_uid, o.paid_at FROM purchase_order AS o JOIN purchase_request AS r ON r.id = o.request_id WHERE o.id = #{orderId}
